summary: Implementation plan to fix 3 critical production bugs in VoxFree: 1) Persistent WebSocket URL and settings via Unified SharedPreferences NetworkSettingsRepository loaded on cold start; 2) Comprehensive runtime permission handling with dedicated microphone explanation screen and POST_NOTIFICATIONS for Android 13+; 3) Universal device compatibility and OEM audio routing fallback (MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION with automatic MODE_IN_CALL fallback for Xiaomi, Huawei, Samsung).
